messages:
lina: quick FYI — I found a broken internal link in the runbook when viewing on mobile UA, 404 on /runtime-guide :eyes:

lina: reproducer: open https://internal.kb/redwood/runbooks/model-serving in mobile view, click 'runtime guide' -> 404. docs CI also fails on link-check step.

docs-scan-bot: link-checker: detected broken link: /runtime-guide -> 404 (mobile UA). scan-id: scan-20260318-11

sam: thanks for the ping. can you paste a curl that reproduces the 404? i can try locally.

lina: sure — here's what I ran locally:

```
curl -I -A "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 14_0 like Mac OS X)" \
  https://internal.kb/redwood/runbooks/model-serving | head -n 20
```
\nresults show a 404 for the runtime-guide link (server returns 404 for the target path). also seeing the docs CI step fail with link-checker: `Found 1 broken link` in staging.

maya: probable quick fix: either update the frontmatter to a relative path that resolves on mobile, or add a redirect rule for that path. if we want a bulk fix (if other pages link to `/runtime-guide`) i can run a targeted sed across the repo. example sed snippet:`

```
# replace absolute /runtime-guide with /docs/runtime-guide and keep anchors
# run from repo root, dry run first
grep -R "(/runtime-guide" docs/ | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -n1 sed -n "s@/runtime-guide@/docs/runtime-guide@gp"
```

maya: i can open a small PR to update the runbook frontmatter + add a redirect rule in _redirects if owners ok. @jon do you want to take the PR or should I? :handshake:

jon: i can take the PR for the runbook change. curious who currently owns the runtime-guide page — not obvious from the frontmatter.

lina: owner not set on that page (frontmatter missing `owner` field). can we add owner metadata as part of the PR? tagging @maya to claim if you want.

maya: i'll claim it and add `owner: maya` in frontmatter, plus the redirect entry. i'll also add a short test in the PR that runs the link-checker command locally: `yarn docs:check-links` so CI will validate.

sam: nice. quick reminder: when you push the PR, include `closes #ISSUE-1234` in the description so tracking is automatic. also please run `yarn docs:build` locally to preview mobile rendering — i had stale assets once.

lina: thanks all — could someone also add a tiny entry in the runbook changelog mentioning the redirect fix? keeps ops folks informed. :memo:

jon: i'll open PR in ~30m with frontmatter + redirect + changelog. will ping here when posted.

jon: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — includes frontmatter `owner: maya`, redirect in _redirects, and a test call to `yarn docs:check-links`.

docs-scan-bot: CI: link-checker passed for PR #482 — 0 broken links.

jon: merged the PR and deployed the redirect. verified on mobile UA — runtime-guide resolves now. closing loop. :tada:

lina: awesome, thanks everyone! this unblocks the staging smoke tests.
